mapper.select: SELECT id, tenant_id, event_id, aggregate_type, aggregate_id, aggregate_version, event_type, topic, payload, status, attempt_count, available_at, occurred_at FROM outbox_event WHERE status IN ('NEW', 'FAILED') AND available_at <= now() AND del_flag = 0 ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT id, tenant_id, target_url, secret_ref FROM webhook_subscription WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND del_flag = 0 AND event_types @> CAST(#{eventTypeJson} AS jsonb)
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO webhook_delivery (tenant_id, subscription_id, event_id, status, attempt_count, next_attempt_at) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{subscriptionId}, #{eventId}, 'PENDING', 0, now()) ON CONFLICT ON CONSTRAINT uq_webhook_delivery_event DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT d.id AS id, d.tenant_id AS tenantId, d.subscription_id AS subscriptionId, d.event_id AS eventId, d.status AS status, d.attempt_count AS attemptCount, s.target_url AS targetUrl, s.secret_ref AS secretRef, CAST(o.event_id AS text) AS outboxEventUuid, o.event_type AS eventType, CAST(o.payload AS text) AS payload, d.create_time AS createTime FROM webhook_delivery d JOIN webhook_subscription s ON s.tenant_id = d.tenant_id AND s.id = d.subscription_id AND s.del_flag = 0 JOIN outbox_event o ON o.tenant_id = d.tenant_id AND o.id = d.event_id AND o.del_flag = 0 WHERE d.status IN ('PENDING', 'RETRY') AND d.next_attempt_at <= now() AND d.del_flag = 0 ORDER BY d.id ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT d.id AS id, d.tenant_id AS tenantId, d.subscription_id AS subscriptionId, d.event_id AS eventId, d.status AS status, d.attempt_count AS attemptCount, s.target_url AS targetUrl, s.secret_ref AS secretRef, CAST(o.event_id AS text) AS outboxEventUuid, o.event_type AS eventType, CAST(o.payload AS text) AS payload, d.create_time AS createTime FROM webhook_delivery d JOIN webhook_subscription s ON s.tenant_id = d.tenant_id AND s.id = d.subscription_id AND s.del_flag = 0 JOIN outbox_event o ON o.tenant_id = d.tenant_id AND o.id = d.event_id AND o.del_flag = 0 WHERE d.id = #{deliveryId} AND d.del_flag = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE webhook_delivery SET status = #{status}, http_status = #{httpStatus}, response_sha256 = #{responseSha256}, last_error_code = #{lastErrorCode}, attempt_count = #{attemptCount}, next_attempt_at = #{nextAttemptAt}, delivered_at = #{deliveredAt}, update_time = now() WHERE id = #{id} AND del_flag = 0
UPDATE webhook_delivery SET status = 'PENDING', attempt_count = 0, next_attempt_at = now(), last_error_code = NULL, update_time = now() WHERE id = #{deliveryId} AND del_flag = 0
UPDATE outbox_event SET status = 'PUBLISHED', published_at = #{publishedAt}, update_time = now() WHERE id = #{id} AND del_flag = 0

UPDATE outbox_event SET status = CASE WHEN #{dead} THEN 'DEAD' ELSE status END, attempt_count = attempt_count + 1, last_error_code = #{errorCode}, available_at = #{availableAt}, dead_letter_at = CASE WHEN #{dead} THEN now() ELSE dead_letter_at END, update_time = now() WHERE id = #{id} AND del_flag = 0
